policyAssessment.explanation: The visible action has the policy-shaped controls: GET checks view_document on Document(pk=pk), and POST checks change_document on that same object before creating a note bound to it. However, both checks use an undefined owner-aware helper. Because the policy expressly rejects ownership as a substitute and owner/grant facts are unspecified, conformance cannot be finalized. The possible model-permission layer adds restrictions but cannot cure an object-level ownership bypass unless its permissions themselves necessarily establish the required grant for that document.

policyAssessment.explanation: The visible action has the policy-shaped controls: GET checks view_document on Document(pk=pk), and POST checks change_document on that same object before creating a note bound to it. However, both checks use an undefined owner-aware helper. Because the policy expressly rejects ownership as a substitute and owner/grant facts are unspecified, conformance cannot be finalized. If the helper admits an owner lacking the corresponding grant, the owner-only GET and/or POST branch violates policy; if it always requires the respective addressed-document grant, those branches conform. The possible model-permission layer adds restrictions but cannot cure an object-level ownership bypass unless its permissions themselves necessarily establish the required grant for that document.
